mapping.shortcomings: Root revision already explains ownership, four connection types, two-way disposable-event checks, hidden versus absent and duplicate caution. Do not generate another generic sync article.
mapping.recommendedWork: Link to provider-specific troubleshooting rather than repeating all steps in each satellite.

mapping.shortcomings: Explains unified view but gives no concrete destination/visibility example. Claims every origin is editable and says Google work sync will never cost anything. Sister article advises deleting other apps.
mapping.recommendedWork: Add one work/family example with permission caveat, preserve ownership, identify source/destination; remove permanence and unnecessary deletion advice. Reconcile tier facts with actual product.

mapping.shortcomings: Existing page covers single-event feed, refresh caveat and read-only nature. No decision matrix distinguishing guest invitation, imported copy, subscription feed and permission-based shared calendar. Google permissions page compresses permissions/private-event differences.
mapping.recommendedWork: Use main share page as decision entry; retain specific permission article for current Google matrix, workplace limits and source citation. Verify App Clip/current sharing implementation. Avoid claiming subscriptions are accepted identically on all devices.

mapping.shortcomings: Existing four articles separate useful questions but remain short opinion essays without an example. Tablet month article implies weather for a whole month; phone month is dismissed too broadly.
mapping.recommendedWork: Expand week page with small view-choice comparison and links to specific views. Use one example week; fix forecast horizon; preserve separate iPad intent only with concrete tablet evidence.

mapping.shortcomings: Five existing short pieces cover surfaces but no actual setup or supported-layout mapping. Generic small=next/medium=today/large=week is presented as universal; Live Activity page promises information correct every glance.
mapping.recommendedWork: Verify actual widget families, explain widget versus Live Activity versus StandBy, add setup and calendar selection, qualify refresh. Blank/stale widget diagnosis is a distinct missing subintent, but first add a tested diagnostic section here before considering another URL.

mapping.shortcomings: Correctly proposes colors and visibility but implies hiding work creates a complete boundary; no distinction between visibility, notifications and permission. Cross-account paid-tier claim needs verification.
mapping.recommendedWork: Add same-example weekday/weekend visibility, clarify hiding does not revoke access or silence alerts, check destination before moving event. No new URL.

mapping.shortcomings: Revised hub resolves general diagnosis. Conflict satellite asserts universal last-write-wins and deleting one duplicate removes both. Shared-calendar article rejects group sharing and generalizes secondary-calendar defaults. Google missing page promises direct APIs show every calendar.
mapping.recommendedWork: Prioritize factual repair of existing satellites; link back to hub. Missing old history is distinct absent subintent and can initially be a provider-specific section in Google missing page; verify iOS history settings applicability.

mapping.shortcomings: Claims all events without explicit zone inherit current zone, ignoring floating/date-time distinctions. Instructs separate start/end zones without verifying app UI. All-day companion claims no conflicts are possible, confusing date representation and free/busy availability.
mapping.recommendedWork: Use provider-backed dated example, distinguish event zone/display zone/floating time/date-only and availability. Verify app supports flight entry behavior; no new travel timezone page.

mapping.shortcomings: Current routine places a few commitments but does not distinguish task deadline from reserved time, buffers or unfinished-block rescheduling. Evidence-free universal productivity claims.
mapping.recommendedWork: Add an original realistic day with fixed meeting, task block, buffer and interruption. Explain manual events without claiming Reminders/task integration. Keep existing slug; time blocking alone does not justify a near duplicate.
